policy: After 09:15 on every live GPW session, the pipeline must end with one best valid stock unless hard data-quality or execution-safety conditions prevent a defensible choice. Historical feature data may lag by at most one completed session and the current-session execution quote must remain fresh. The final selector reranks the strongest quantitative candidates with bounded Opening Confirmation and then applies the shared empirical Expected Value model from gpw_daily_pick_config.json. The target R/R is selected from the configured grid by uncertainty-adjusted net expected R; no fixed 1.8 R target is imposed when the EV model is enabled.
